text: Waited over 4 hours in the Emergency Room with severe abdominal pain before anyone even took my vitals. The triage desk was completely chaotic and nobody gave any updates on when a doctor would be available.

Dr. Ramesh and the cardiology nursing team on the 4th floor were extraordinarily attentive and compassionate during my father's post-op recovery. They explained every medication and monitored him round the clock.

Received a surprise bill of ₹45,000 for diagnostic lab tests that the insurance desk explicitly assured me were 100% pre-authorized under cashless coverage. Billing staff refused to assist when I asked for an itemized invoice.
The patient room and ICU hallways were impeccably sanitized and clean. However, the air conditioning unit in room 302 was rattling loudly all night and made it very hard for the patient to rest.
The CarePulse mobile app kept crashing whenever I attempted to join the scheduled video consultation with Dr. Sen. By the time I could log back in, the slot was marked as missed and I had to rebook.
The outpatient orthopedic consultation was right on time. Dr. Kulkarni gave a clear diagnosis of my meniscus tear and showed me the MRI scan slice by slice without rushing the consultation.
The reception desk staff at the main lobby were remarkably dismissive and rude when my elderly mother asked for wheelchair assistance. We had to locate and fetch an empty wheelchair ourselves.
My blood test was scheduled for 8:30 AM but the phlebotomist did not arrive until 9:45 AM. The blood draw itself was painless and quick, but the delay forced me to miss a work meeting.

The hospital pharmacy charged me twice on my credit card for the prescribed asthma inhalers. When I pointed out the duplicate swipe on my SMS alert, the cashier asked me to return on Monday for a refund.
Using the CarePulse portal to review my blood lipid profile and discharge summary was seamless. The results arrived in the app within 4 hours of the sample collection with clear reference ranges.
Excellent nursing care in the pediatric ward. The pediatricians were very gentle with my 3-year-old daughter. The only issue was the visitor parking lot which was completely full with no valet.
Post-surgery discharge process took nearly 6 hours after the doctor signed off at 10 AM. We sat in the hallway waiting for the pharmacy clearance and billing stamps until 4:15 PM.
Dr. Ananya Roy in the neurology clinic provided exceptional care. She spent 45 minutes listening to my migraine symptoms and customized a preventive treatment plan that has already brought relief.
Restrooms on the 2nd floor outpatient wing were completely untidy with no hand soap and water pooling near the sinks. For a tertiary hospital this is an unacceptable hygiene standard.
Medical care was satisfactory, but the patient portal does not allow downloading PDF receipts for tax submission. I had to physically visit the accounts department to obtain a stamped receipt.
Transparent billing experience. The financial counselor gave an upfront estimate for the laparoscopic hernia surgery, and the final invoice at discharge matched the estimate down to the rupee.
The resident on duty in the morning round barely spent 30 seconds examining my surgical incision and did not answer my questions about ongoing fever. Felt very neglected as an inpatient.
Scheduled consultation with the dermatologist was handled efficiently. Clean waiting area and digital token display kept everyone informed of their queue position.
The hospital pharmacy was missing two essential antibiotics prescribed by the discharge physician. I had to travel to another commercial pharmacy late at night to purchase them.

Appointment booking through the mobile app showed Dr. Joshi available on Tuesday, but when I arrived at the clinic the receptionist informed me the doctor was on leave. The app should reflect doctor leaves.
The maternity ward nurses provided outstanding round-the-clock support. Their lactation guidance and patient encouragement made our first delivery experience smooth and stress-free.
Billing department added duplicate ICU monitoring charges for a day my mother was already moved to the step-down room. Resolving this took three phone calls and endless arguing.
The MRI imaging department was very prompt and handled claustrophobia concerns gently. Results were linked to my CarePulse portal within 12 hours.
Extreme wait times in the ultrasound wing. Patients with appointment tokens at 11 AM were called at 2:30 PM without any notification or explanation of emergency disruptions.
Day-care chemotherapy center was peaceful, spotless, and staffed by wonderful oncology nurses who administered medication with extreme precision and empathy.
The doctors are top notch, but the hospital cafeteria food is stale and cold. For patients on special diabetic diets, there were very limited healthy meal choices.
Forgot password option on the patient portal does not send the reset OTP to registered Indian mobile numbers. Tried four times and had to call customer support.
Nurse administered intravenous painkiller too rapidly despite my warning about previous dizziness, causing immediate nausea and vertigo. Better clinical adherence to infusion rates is required.
Prompt outpatient billing at counter 3. The staff member was polite, applied my corporate discount immediately, and handed over an organized receipt folder.
Wait time to collect prescribed medicines from the central pharmacy exceeded 50 minutes. Only two of the six counters were staffed during the peak 6 PM rush hour.
Physical therapy rehabilitation team designed a very practical knee exercise program. My range of motion has improved significantly within two weeks.
Security staff at the gate was shouting at visitors and refused entry to my husband during permitted evening visiting hours despite showing the patient pass.
Telehealth consultation with the endocrinologist was crisp, audio-video quality was flawless, and the electronic prescription was uploaded to the app within 2 minutes.
Insurance TPA desk took over 8 hours to submit the initial pre-authorization query to Star Health, unnecessarily delaying my planned gallbladder surgery.
Medical treatment was effective, but the room linen had visible stains and was not replaced until I reminded the housekeeping staff twice.
The ENT surgeon Dr. Mehta explained the sinus procedure clearly and alleviated all my anxieties. Post-op follow up check was completely free of charge.
Waited 3 hours in the pediatric OPD with a baby running 102 fever. Even emergency triage showed no urgency in assigning a junior doctor to check temperature.
The digital lab reports are convenient, but the app should allow parents to switch between their own medical records and their dependent children's profiles seamlessly.
Pharmacy billed an expensive brand-name supplement instead of the generic multivitamin written on the prescription without asking my preference.
Nurse Sister Mary on the 5th floor oncology ward is a true angel. Her kindness, warmth, and gentle IV cannulation made a difficult day much easier.
Wheelchair ramp near the casualty entrance was obstructed by parked hospital delivery vans. It was extremely dangerous pushing my father across the curb.
Diagnostic ultrasound was conducted with high professionalism. The radiologist patiently explained the liver findings and provided the printed report within 30 minutes.
CarePulse app keeps logging me out every 5 minutes. When looking at long CT scan reports, having to enter biometrics and 2FA repeatedly is frustrating.
The dialysis center staff adheres to strict hygiene and sterilization protocols. Dialysis technician Manoj is skilled and always cheerful.
Cashless insurance desk demanded a ₹15,000 cash deposit for admission despite an active corporate cashless policy with 100% room rent coverage. Highly unethical.
Doctor consultation was great, but the outpatient queue calling system was broken, resulting in people jumping queues and shouting at the nurse.
Good sanitation in the corridors and sanitizers placed outside every patient room. Hospital feels clean and well ventilated.
Rapid response by the cardiac emergency team when my father experienced chest discomfort. EKG was done within 3 minutes and the cardiologist arrived immediately.
Front office executive was arguing on personal phone call while a line of 6 patients was waiting to collect discharge summary folders.
Laboratory portal uploaded another patient's urine culture report into my account. This is a severe HIPAA and patient data privacy violation.
Billing process was transparent, and the accounts team explained the hospital consumables charges line by line before taking payment.
Waiting time for the echo-cardiogram was 2.5 hours past the appointment time. Elderly cardiac patients should not be made to sit on metal benches this long.
Dr. Sunita Kulkarni is one of the best gynecologists in the city. Her diagnosis was accurate and she avoided recommending unnecessary surgical interventions.
Room 408 had a leaking bathroom tap that kept dripping loudly onto the bucket. Housekeeping promised a plumber but nobody showed up during my 2-day stay.
Telehealth appointment was okay, but the doctor joined 20 minutes late with no apology or message from the clinic coordinator.
The patient counseling department helped us navigate complex insurance approvals with patience and secured cashless clearance within an hour.
Blood sample collection caused a massive hematoma on my arm because the technician was in a hurry and did not apply proper pressure dressing.
We were made to wait from 9 AM to 3 PM for a routine ultrasound because hospital prioritized walk-in VIP patients over confirmed online appointments.
The digital discharge process through the CarePulse portal saved us a lot of time. Prescriptions and follow-up slots were automatically populated in the calendar.
The nursing supervisors on the 3rd floor are phenomenal. They anticipated patient needs, kept the room sanitized, and treated my grandfather with deep dignity.
Surprise billing charge of ₹8,500 for 'sanitization kits and administrative handling' that was not disclosed during the pre-admission financial estimate.
Air conditioning broke down in the post-operative recovery room during peak summer. Patients were sweating and nurses had to bring small pedestal fans.
Prompt vaccination clinic for infants. The pediatrician gave comprehensive post-vaccination fever management advice and entered the batch details in the app.
CarePulse app does not send reminder notifications before specialist appointments. Missed my ophthalmologist review because I relied on the app calendar alert.
Dr. Rajesh Iyer diagnosed my chronic autoimmune condition after 3 other hospitals had failed. His treatment regimen has given me my life back.
Night shift nursing staff was chatting loudly and watching videos near the nurse station, making it impossible for surgical recovery patients to sleep.
Emergency room pharmacy queue took 45 minutes for urgent anti-emetic injections. Emergency medications must have a dedicated fast-track window.
Very clean hospital premises, wide corridors, and clear directional signboards everywhere. Escalators and elevators were clean and operational.
Online appointment booking on the CarePulse portal was frictionless. Got instant confirmation SMS and WhatsApp directions with parking gate instructions.
Final bill contained charges for two consultations with a visiting nephrologist who never came to the room. Had to wait 2 hours at discharge to get it removed.
The doctor is competent, but bedside manners could be improved. Spoke only to the medical intern and barely acknowledged my mother who was in pain.
Exceptional cataract surgery outcome by the ophthalmology unit. Fast, painless, and discharge was completed within two hours with clear eye drop schedules.
Lab test results took 48 hours instead of the promised 12 hours. We had to postpone our doctor consultation because the liver panel was not uploaded.
Hospital maintains high sanitation in high-touch areas like elevator buttons and door handles. Hand sanitizer dispensers were full at every corner.
CarePulse Android app crashes immediately on startup on Android 14. Cannot view my father's ongoing prescription list or contact doctor.
Billing staff was extremely courteous. They processed my Mediclaim claim quickly and handed back the original discharge folder in proper order.
Triage doctor in casualty seemed inexperienced and dismissed high fever as mild viral without ordering basic blood tests. We had to insist on a dengue test which came back positive.
Waited 3.5 hours for an MRI scan appointment that was pre-booked two days in advance. No drinking water was available in the basement radiology waiting hall.
Daycare surgery team was organized. Pre-op briefing by the anesthesiologist was thorough and put my mind at complete ease.
Front office staff member refused to accept digital payments via UPI claiming server downtime, insisting on cash when the hospital ATM was out of cash.
Dr. Pradeep Rao and the nephrology nursing staff provided world-class clinical care during my aunt's kidney biopsy. Procedure was completely painless.
The patient room toilet had a foul smell and was not cleaned for over 24 hours despite raising a complaint on the in-room touch panel.
Prescription refill feature on the portal is confusing. It asks for doctor signature upload even for recurring chronic hypertension medicines.
Smooth and stress-free insurance settlement. The billing supervisor coordinated directly with HDFC ERGO and the approval came through in 35 minutes.
Wait time at the sample collection phlebotomy lab was over an hour on a Saturday morning. There were only two phlebotomists for 80 waiting patients.
The hospital is well equipped with modern ICU facilities and ventilators. Doctors in the pulmonology team are experienced and caring.
Doctor rushed through the 5-minute consultation without listening to my chronic stomach pain history, prescribed three expensive medicines and moved to the next patient.
Nurse Anita in the post-surgical ICU monitored my oxygen saturation and vitals with utmost vigilance. Her caring touch and warmth gave our family great reassurance.
Hospital billing desk charged an extra ₹2,000 for emergency consultation even though I arrived during normal OPD hours. No explanation was provided.
The hospital building is clean and modern, but finding parking took 30 minutes due to poor signage and lack of attendants.
CarePulse app sent me an instant notification when my thyroid test was ready, allowing me to share the PDF directly with my doctor on WhatsApp.
Severe delays in blood sample pickup from the 3rd floor ward meant tests had to be redrawn because the sample sat at room temperature for 4 hours.
General ward was clean and beds were spaced properly. Housekeeping staff swept and mopped twice a day with disinfectant.
The customer care phone number listed on the portal kept ringing with no response when I called to reschedule an ultrasound.
Outstanding physiotherapy session for lumbar spondylosis. The therapist explained the biomechanics and gave an easy home workout chart.
Billing counter was understaffed during evening discharge hours. Patients and families stood in a single queue for over an hour just to clear bills.
Consultation with the pediatric cardiologist was reassuring. The doctor answered all our questions patiently and outlined clear follow-up milestones.
The hospital wheelchair available at casualty was squeaking, had a torn seat, and one footrest was completely broken.
Telehealth follow-up was prompt and convenient. Saved an elderly patient from traveling across the city for a 5-minute prescription renewal.
Surgeon was 3 hours late for a scheduled elective morning surgery without any prior update to the waiting patient and anxious family.
The wait time at the inpatient pharmacy counter at 8 PM was over 45 minutes with only one executive handling a queue of 25 patients.
Nursing staff during day shifts are polite and proactive, but the night shift nurses seem disengaged and slow to answer patient calls.
Exceptional clinical care in the Neonatal ICU. The neonatology team managed our premature baby's respiratory distress with unmatched expertise and daily updates.
